title: client_id/client_secret optional in token exchange
description: api.rs:747-769. The token exchange endpoint treats client_id and client_secret as optional. If a client omits them entirely, the authorization code is exchanged for a token without any client authentication. This violates RFC 6749 Section 4.1.3 for confidential clients and allows any party who intercepts an authorization code to exchange it for a token. Since the server generates and stores client_secret (line 353), all registered clients are implicitly confidential and should be required to authenticate at the token endpoint.
